page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin, each beside its observation (ib. with a number, marked by a symbol). Running head at top: "Num. Praeceptor." and "Cap. VI." Page number 451 at top right; running title "Theologia Judaica." above the rule.

main_text.p: ftendunt septem plagas quæ debentur legis transgressoribus, Levit. 26. 28. Et hoc est quod dixit Moses. Ecce ego proposui vobis vitam & mortem, id est, 613 præcepta ad vitam, & septem plagas ad mortem.
ib. 1Observ. 22 Non habebis Deos alienos coram me.
ib. 4Observ. 23 Non facies sculptile neque tibi neque aliis: neque factum in usum tuum emas.
ib. 5Observ. 24 Ne incurves vel prosternas te coram idololatris nullo modo.
ib. 6Observ. 25 Non est serviendum idololatris eo modo quo solent cultores eorum illis deservire.
ib. 7Observ. 26 Ne sumito nomen ejus in vanum, id est, sine necessitate.
ib. 10Observ. 28 Die Sabbathi non est laborandum.
Observ. 30 Non debes innocentem interficere. ib. 13
Observ. 31 Ne furere animam ex fratribus tuis, id est, Israeliticis. ib. 14

page.notes: Marginal reference numbers beside the observations are partly illegible in the scan; the readings given are approximate. Catchword "De" at foot of page is read from "32 De". Greek and Hebrew not present.
